item.title: Orforglipron and Weight Loss
item.description:
• Summary: Data presented at ECO 2026 on orforglipron, an oral GLP-1 receptor agonist from Eli Lilly, demonstrated sustained weight loss over extended treatment periods. The drug is being developed as a convenient once-daily oral option for obesity, potentially capturing a large market segment.
  • MoAs: Oral GLP-1 receptor agonist (promotes satiety and slows gastric emptying, leading to weight loss)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Gut Hormone Signals in T1D and Obesity
item.description:
• Summary: A study presented at ECO 2026 shows that gut hormone signals differ between individuals with type 1 diabetes and those with obesity, indicating distinct metabolic pathways that could inform targeted therapies.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
